更新内容
• 本版本起转为收费应用：采用免费试用加一次性买断模式（Microsoft Store 渠道），试用期内开放全部功能；试用结束后需购买完整版才能继续使用卷积校正、DSD 位流输出（DoP/Native）、5.1 多声道输出与 Atmos HDMI 直通，基础播放、均衡器及其余 DSP 音效保持免费；已保存的设置不会丢失，购买后自动恢复生效
• 新增首次启动用户协议确认：内置用户协议、隐私政策与免责声明全文，需同意后方可使用；「设置 → 关于」页新增协议与隐私政策在线查看入口
• 卷积校正支持按输出设备绑定：可为每台输出设备（耳机/音箱/ASIO）保存独立校正曲线，插拔或切换输出设备时自动应用对应校正，未绑定的设备自动旁路卷积
• 卷积校正编辑改为即时生效：拖动控制点、切换预设立即生效并自动保存；无音频输出时也可离线编辑草稿，播放开始后实时生效
• 新增音乐库与收藏页空状态引导页，支持直接从占位页添加或拖入音乐文件夹
• 启动不再等待文件扫描：主界面就绪即可浏览和播放，媒体库增量扫描转入后台并显示进度，完成后自动合并且不打断当前播放
• 重构添加文件链路：歌曲分批渐进上架，扫描期间自动互斥重复操作
• 标签编辑改为延迟写入：文件被占用（如正在播放）时编辑立即生效于曲库，待文件可写后自动补写，跨重启不丢失
• 目录监视更可靠：关闭时彻底停止监视并取消扫描，重新开启即时恢复；多次文件变更自动合并为一次扫描
• 新增「播放详情页在前台时隐藏桌面歌词」选项；桌面歌词显示/隐藏不再抢占焦点，隐藏时暂停渲染以降低占用
• 歌词体验改进：无歌词时显示友好提示；修复网络异常被误判为无歌词导致此后不再自动搜索的问题，联网恢复后会自动补搜
• 修复切换到无封面歌曲时旧封面与主题色背景残留、默认封面不跟随明暗主题、着色器取色错误的问题；快速连续切歌不再显示过期封面
• 修复快速连点播放/暂停时操作被静默丢弃的问题，现保留最后一次操作意图
• 卷积校正与输出设备切换更即时顺滑；音频设置改为原子保存，文件损坏时自动备份恢复
en:
Release Notes
• The app is becoming paid starting with this version: free trial with a one-time full-version purchase (via Microsoft Store). All features are open during the trial; after it ends, purchase the full version to keep using convolution correction, DSD bitstream output (DoP/Native), 5.1 multichannel output, and Atmos HDMI passthrough. Core playback, the equalizer, and the remaining DSP effects stay free. Saved settings are never lost and are restored automatically after purchase
• New first-run user agreement consent: the full user agreement, privacy policy, and disclaimer are built in and must be accepted before use; the "Settings → About" page adds online links to them
• Convolution correction can now be bound per output device: save an independent correction curve for each output device (headphones/speakers/ASIO); the matching curve is applied automatically when devices are plugged, removed, or switched, and unbound devices bypass convolution
• Convolution correction editing is now immediate: dragging control points or switching presets takes effect and saves instantly; curves can also be edited offline with no audio output, taking effect live once playback starts
• New empty-state guidance pages for the music library and favorites, with direct add/drop of music folders from the placeholder
• Startup no longer waits for the file scan: the UI is ready immediately for browsing and playback, incremental library scanning runs in the background with a progress indicator, and results merge automatically without interrupting playback
• Reworked the add-files pipeline: songs appear progressively in batches with operations guarded during scans
• Tag edits are now written lazily: editing no longer fails when a file is busy (e.g. playing) — the change applies to the library immediately and is written to the file automatically once writable, surviving restarts
• More reliable folder watching: turning it off now fully releases watchers and cancels scans, and it resumes instantly when re-enabled; multiple file changes are merged into a single scan
• New option to hide desktop lyrics while the now-playing detail page is in the foreground; showing/hiding desktop lyrics no longer steals focus, and rendering pauses while hidden to reduce overhead
• Lyrics improvements: a friendly placeholder when no lyrics are found; fixed network errors being misjudged as "no lyrics", which stopped future auto-searches — searches now retry automatically once back online
• Fixed stale cover art and theme-color background lingering when switching to songs without covers, default covers not following the light/dark theme, and wrong shader color extraction; rapid track switching no longer shows outdated covers
• Fixed rapid play/pause clicks being silently dropped; the latest intent is now preserved
• Convolution and output-device switching are snappier; audio settings are now saved atomically with automatic backup recovery if the file is corrupted
